title: Fairness Testing: A Comprehensive Survey and Analysis of Trends

bias_targets.methodology: Surveying existing fairness testing literature and datasets that evaluate sex and gender bias using techniques like metamorphic testing, search-based test generation, and statistical metrics.
Reviewing fairness testing research that measures bias related to race, ethnicity, and skin tone through counterfactual data generation and statistical fairness oracles.
Summarizing studies that evaluate age-related bias in ML software using targeted test input generation and metamorphic relations.
Cataloging fairness testing techniques and datasets that identify biases based on country, nationality, or geographic origin.
Surveying literature that detects bias associated with occupation or profession in machine learning systems.
Identifying research papers and datasets within the survey that assess ML models for religious bias.
Reviewing automated fairness testing methodologies and benchmarks evaluating bias based on sexual orientation.
Examining fairness testing literature that addresses bias related to physical or mental ability.
Surveying datasets and testing tools that measure political ideology bias in natural language generation and other ML tasks.
Highlighting fairness testing studies evaluating social status bias using various test oracles and data generation techniques.
